concerns.text: SC-003 requires the pipeline to complete within 6 h on a free‑tier runner, but the verification step for T009 only checks file existence and JSON keys; it does not measure or enforce the runtime limit, leaving the success criterion unverified.

SC-001 mandates that the primary correlation coefficient be evaluated against the null‑distribution expectation, yet the verification for T009/T010 merely checks that JSON fields exist and that a histogram PNG is present; it does not verify that the primary result exceeds or is compared to the null distribution.

FR-005 specifies a bootstrap with ≥ 1000 iterations, but T009’s verification only asserts that CI fields are present in the JSON output, without confirming the iteration count, so the functional requirement is not enforced.

SC-005 calls for an explicit acknowledgement of the single‑test nature (or a multiple‑comparison correction) in the report, yet T011’s verification only checks AIC/BIC values and a plot; it does not ensure such a statement is recorded, violating the success criterion.

Tasks T013‑T015 are not linked to any FR or SC in the specification; they introduce additional scope (summary JSON, checksum file, handoff markdown) without corresponding requirement coverage, constituting an orphaned expansion of the project scope.

The constitution (Principle I & II) requires all random seeds to be pinned for reproducibility, yet none of the tasks mention setting or verifying RNG seeds, risking a breach of the Reproducibility principle.
